title: Script editor, find bar (ctrl f) hides cursor line
body: ### Tested versions Reproducible in: - v4.7.dev2.official - v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] ### System information Godot v4.7.dev2 - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - GeForce GTX 550 Ti - Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2100 CPU @ 3.10GHz (4 threads) - 11.95 GiB memory ### Issue description The find and replace bar hides the current line at the bottom of the script editor. ### Expected Scroll the current line above the find and replace bar. v4.7.dev2.official [778cf54da] - ctrl + f hides last line - ctrl + r hides last three lines When there's an error message: Error at ... An example error is to define two variables with the same name: ``` extends Node var abc = 1 # add blank lines here to push the next var definition # to the bottom of the script window var abc = 1 ``` - ctrl + f hides last line and a half of next to last line - ctrl + r hides last three lines v4.6.1.stable.official [14d19694e] - ctrl + f hides last line but it also scrolls down line 50, below the script window Note, 4.7 dev2 might have fixed the last line scrolling down, because it doesn't happen there, see the screenshots above. - ctrl + r hides last two and a half lines When there's an error message: Error at ... - ctrl + f hides last line and the bottom of next to last line - ctrl + r hides last three lines ### Steps to reproduce - open the project: issue-find-and-replace-bar-hides-current-line.zip - open `new_script.gd` - scroll to the bottom of the script - click on line 50 to place the cursor there: `var abc = 1` - press: `ctrl + r` to open the find and replace bar Issue: The current line (with the cursor), becomes hidden by the find and replace bar. Expected: Scroll the current line above the find and replace bar. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [issue-find-and-replace-bar-hides-current-line.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25771575/issue-find-and-replace-bar-hides-current-line.zip)
